description: A struck resonator: one damped mass on a spring, set ringing by the button or by an impulse fed into it

params.text: Sets how fast the ringing dies away, over a range of ten octaves of damping; the far left rings for a long time and the far right stops almost at once
Sets the pitch of the ringing, over a range of about eleven octaves
Pressing it strikes the resonator once
Nothing in the module reads this knob: it is placed on the panel but no configuration and no processing refers to it, so turning it changes nothing and it carries no tooltip

inputs.text: Feeds an impulse into the resonator; the rate of change of this voltage is added to the displacement each sample, so a click drives it and a steady voltage does not

outputs.text: The ringing, five times the resonator's displacement

notes: This module is unfinished and wears A Saw B's panel artwork: every word printed on it, and the module browser's description of it as a variable hardness clipper, belongs to another module
It also has a trigger input declared in the code with no jack drawn for it, so the button is the only way to strike it apart from the impulse jack
